disposition: Health is reported separately from convergence at both the member seam and the public construction seam, with typed Responsive/Stale/Degraded/Unavailable statuses and bounded content-free conflict observations. Gap: the full V1 status vocabulary (assigned/active/unknown including the no-destination case) is absent, observation logs are in-memory and clear on restart, and there is no heartbeat/pending-count aggregation or cross-Region roll-up.
